chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Qattan narrated to us, saying: Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Husayni narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari narrated to me, saying: Abdullah ibn Bahr al-Ahwazi narrated to me, saying: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Amr narrated to me, saying: Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Jumhur narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Bilal narrated to me, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from Musa ibn Ja'far, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family), from Jibril, from Mikail, from Israfil, from the Tablet, from the Pen,

It said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, says: 'The Wilayah (Divine Authority) of Ali ibn Abi Talib - Allah's blessings be upon him - is My Shield. Hence, whoever enters My Shield is safe from My Fire.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ali ibn Abi Talib's Wilayah as a shield from Hellfire?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith features a unique 'chain of chains' (silsilat al-silsilat) tracing back through the celestial beings to the Preserved Tablet, emphasizing the cosmic and eternal nature of Ali's Wilayah. It establishes his spiritual authority not merely as a political designation but as a divine 'fortress' (hissn) that guarantees salvation from the Hellfire for those who adhere to it. This concept reinforces the Shia doctrine of *Wilayah al-Takwiniyyah*, where the Imam serves as the intermediary of divine protection and grace.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Abdul-Rahman bin Muhammed al-Hussaini, that he said: I was told by Muhammed bin Ibrahim bin Muhammed al-Fazari, that he said: I was told by Abdullah bin Bahr al-Ahwazi, that he said: I was told by Abu’l-Hasan, Ali bin Amru, that he said: We were told by Hasan bin Muhammed bin Jumhour, that he said: I was told by Ali bin Bilal, from Ali bin Musa al-Rida, from Musa bin Ja’far, from Ja’far bin Muhammed, from Muhammed bin Ali, from Ali bin Hussain, from Hussain bin Ali, from Ali bin Abi Talib, peace be upon them, from the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, from JIbra’eel, from Mika’eel, from Israfeel, from the Tablet, from the Pen,
that it said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, says: The Divine Authority of Ali bin Abi Talib, Allah’s blessings be upon him, is My Shield. Hence, the one who enters My Shield is safe from My Fire.
